Name: PinkStations Cotton Candy Interface
Author: PinkStations
Description:
[size=5][b]~PinkStations Cotton Candy Interface~
[/b][/size][size=3]
A pretty customizable interface based on bright and cute colors!

This interface is customizable! There are 3 color options (Accent, Background, and Border) that lets you change the interface to look however you'd like!
[/size]
[size=3]I've also made sure that [b]all languages[/b] are fully compatible!![/size]

[size=4][b]Currently Compatible With:[/b] [/size][color=#ff00ff] [size=3]*Note: you have to manually replace the buttons. Please see the README.txt for instructions*[/size][/color]
[size=3]~ Generic Mod Config Menu
[/size][size=3]~ Convenient Inventory[/size]
[size=3]Let me know what other compatibility you'd like to see![/size]
[b]
[size=4]Requirements:[/size][/b]
[size=3]~ [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]
[size=3]~ [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url][size=3]~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14525]Theme Manager[/url] *required, the interface will not apply without it!*
~ [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3]  *This is not required but [b]HIGHLY[/b] recommended for ease of changing configurable options!*[/size]

[size=4][b]How to Install:[/b][/size]
[size=3]~ Download and then unzip[/size]
[size=3]~ Put the unzipped folder into your mods folder[/size]
[size=3]~ Run the game and enjoy your pretty interface![/size]
